title: Deputy Manager I&C
jobDescription:
CHART INDUSTRIES, INC. (Chart) (NYSE: GTLS) is a leading independent global manufacturer of highly engineered equipment and services related to cryogenic gas processing and rotating equipment. In the cryogenic sector, the Chart brand is synonymous with the liquefaction, distribution, and storage of liquid gases, including oxygen, nitrogen, LNG, biogas, hydrogen, helium, and carbon dioxide. The acquisition of Howden expanded our portfolio to include air and gas handling products such as compressors, cooling fans, steam turbines, and more, expanding our offering of products and solutions across traditional markets and providing access to new ones such as nuclear, energy recovery, tunnel ventilation, mine safety, and electrification.
- Undertake the design of Instrumentation & Electrical control for Howden equipment packages supplied for various industries.
- Execute Electrical and Controls Design activities relating to the packaging and Commissioning of Howden Compressors, Blowers for Indian Market in compliance to Howden std and customer/project requirements.
- Assist all other Howden India departments in all aspects of control and instrumentation for contract or proposal execution.
- Give technical advice and assistance to customers on Howden’s C&I technology.
- Build Control & Instrumentation capability in India to reduce cost of Engineering and response time on Compressors, Blower Packages for Indian Market.
- Provide Engineering specification to Procurement and support in clarifications with Vendors.
- Provide technical support for proposals – control systems, communication interfaces and instrumentation.
- Actively participate in commissioning at site during installation as and when required.
- Work in tandem with Howden mechanical design engineers to design C&I systems for Howden products.
- Write technical specifications to define purchased items.
- Produce cabling, wiring and block schematic drawings of main C&I components using Autocad or appropriate software tools.
- Approve and review C&I, technical specifications and drawings produced by mechanical design engineer.
- Utilise knowledge and/or experience to provide support to other Howden engineers and all other departments as required.
- Conduct or attend testing of C&I products (including purchased items) and provide a written report within agreed time frameworks.
- BE in Instrumentation / Electrical Engineering (or equivalent) with more than 08 years of hands on experience from similar background.
- Good practical C&I skills.
- Experience in C&I design, large/small motors, drive packages and actuators.
- Experience in Designing of Control panel / control philosophy and basic understanding of PLC programming.
- Knowledge of Process Industry specifications and standard.
- Working experience on various PLCs, control circuits and various PLC Network protocols.
- Preferably from Rotating Equipment Manufacturing Industry.
- Visit site for equipment assessment or troubleshooting purposes.
- Preparation of technical reports and submissions
- Technical presentations to customers/customer meetings
- Computer literacy, competency in MS Office applications
- Proficiency in Auto Cad and knowledge of Inventor.
- Good verbal and written communication skills
- Knowledge of programmable systems including ladder diagrams.
- ATEX/CCOE and other equivalent std knowledge.
- Excellent Problem solving ability

title: Design Engineer - Compressor Package
jobDescription:
CHART INDUSTRIES, INC. (Chart) (NYSE: GTLS) is a leading independent global manufacturer of highly engineered equipment and services related to cryogenic gas processing and rotating equipment. In the cryogenic sector, the Chart brand is synonymous with the liquefaction, distribution, and storage of liquid gases, including oxygen, nitrogen, LNG, biogas, hydrogen, helium, and carbon dioxide. The acquisition of Howden expanded our portfolio to include air and gas handling products such as compressors, cooling fans, steam turbines, and more, expanding our offering of products and solutions across traditional markets and providing access to new ones such as nuclear, energy recovery, tunnel ventilation, mine safety, and electrification.
- We are seeking for a Mechanical Design Systems Engineer responsible for the design and engineering of complete reciprocating compressor packages (Piston/Diaphragm).
- This role covers package design, system integration, fabrication support, new product development and product enhancements aligned with global engineering standards.
- Specify and size system components to support compressors and auxiliary systems.
- Collaborate with internal engineering teams and external partners to ensure design accuracy and first-time quality.
- Prepare and review General Arrangements, P&IDs, 3D models, datasheets,manufacturing drawings and Bills of Material.
- Conduct engineering analyses using internal tools, spreadsheets and manual calculations across strength of materials, statics, dynamics, thermodynamics, vibrations, and noise.
- Review and interpret customer and project specifications, ensuring full compliance and alignment with agreed scope.
- Prepare technical reports, engineering procedures, and documentation in support of project execution.
- Evaluate sub-supplier drawings, datasheets, and procedures to ensure seamless integration and technical conformity.
- Work cross-functionally with project management and supply chain teams to maintain scope clarity, schedule adherence, and cost control.
- Engage with customers to provide technical clarifications, design reviews and engineering support throughout the project lifecycle.
- Support manufacturing, aftermarket and field service teams with design guidance, troubleshooting, and issue resolution.
- Provide engineering inputs for sales, proposals, supply-chain development, product enhancements and continuous improvement initiatives.
- Collaborate with central functions such as Quality, Engineering, Finance, IT and HR to align with organizational strategies.
- Bachelor’s degree in mechanical engineering (or equivalent).
- 5+ years of design experience in air/gas handling, rotating equipment, or heavy industrial environments.
- Strong understanding of engineering basics, drawings and bills of material.
- Familiarity with Oil and Gas industry standards (ANSI, ASME, ASTM, API, SAE).
- Basic proficiency in engineering software (Autodesk Inventor, Creo, Auto CAD, Navisworks) and strong command on Microsoft Office tools.
- Knowledge of heavy industrial fabrication, welding standards, and mechanical systems (lubrication, cooling, gas lines).
- Excellent problem-solving, organizational, and decision-making abilities.
- Strong communication skills and ability to manage multiple projects independently.

title: Assistant Manager - Proposals
jobDescription:
Chart Industries is a leading global manufacturer of highly engineered equipment and solutions serving multiple applications in the Energy, Industrial, and Industrial Gas end markets. In March 2023 Chart Industries acquired the Howden Group, and the combined group is now represented in over 40 countries worldwide with over 11,700 employees. Our vision is to enable the vital processes of our customers and thereby promote a more sustainable world via our Nexus of Clean™ strategy. The combination of Chart and Howden furthers our global leadership position in process technologies with products and services in applications such as hydrogen, carbon capture, energy recovery, nuclear, water treatment, mining, and LNG to name a few. Together with customer-focused service solutions, including an extensive service network and market-leading digital diagnostics, we support our customers through the complete lifecycle of their assets. At Chart we have a strong corporate identity and a clear purpose
- you will be a member of our team shaping the future of the company and participating in helping our customers and the world tackle some of the planet's most pressing issues.
- Responsible for handling inquiries from Indian & Export Market related to Centrifugal & Axial Fans, Blowers Techno commercial proposal covering all segments mainly Steel, Cement, Oil & Gas, Power ,General Industries..

- Make, prepare, agree and monitor proposals based on inquiries received from the clients.
- Make, prepare, agree, revise and monitor proposals cost make up sheet is reflected in the proposal on each revision.

- Educated to Degree level or equivalent in Mechanical engineering discipline.

title: Manufacturing Engineer - Cooling Fans

CHART INDUSTRIES, INC. (Chart) (NYSE: GTLS) is a leading independent global manufacturer of highly engineered equipment and services related to cryogenic gas processing and rotating equipment. In the cryogenic sector, the Chart brand is synonymous with the liquefaction, distribution, and storage of liquid gases, including oxygen, nitrogen, LNG, biogas, hydrogen, helium, and carbon dioxide. - The Assembly and Testing In Charge oversees the daily operations of assembling and testing assigned projects. This role involves:
- Planning and directing assembly and testing activities.
- Identifying &communicating material shortages to relevant stakeholders ensuring project timelines are met.
- Monitoring and optimizing assembly and testing processes for efficiency and effectiveness.
- Ensuring on-time delivery of completed projects to meet customer deadlines (CDD)."
- The Assembly and Testing in Charge is responsible for:
- Conduct Job Safety Analyses (JSAs) and frequent safety audits to identify and eliminate unsafe conditions and acts.
- Identify and mitigate assembly defects.
- Conduct Failure Mode and Effects Analysis (FMEA) to prevent future failures.
- Communicate part-level rejections to buyers/vendors prior to assembly.
- Validate final assembly with mould checks.
- Prepare dimensional reports and submit them to Quality Control (QC).
- Review and reinforce fan part aesthetics in coordination with QC.
- Arrange necessary equipment (moulds, mixing machine, lamination prep, stem moulds) in advance.
- Support QC in resolving performance deviations during mould prep and laying.
- Prepare assembly micro-plans based on expected material receipt dates.
- Ensure timely highlighting of material issues and record in COPQ.
- Communicate material shortages to planning/buyer/ production to meet customer deadlines (CDD).
- Optimise operational costs by minimizing manufacturing costs (labour, welding, power).
- Ensure effective usage and maintain records of production consumables.

RESPONSIBILITIES:
Prepare detailed monthly performance reports and present to HOD. Lead 5S and Kaizen activities across assembly and testing Degree or Diploma in Mechanical Engineering with 6-11 years of experience, including 4-5 yrs in FRP processes, is mandatory.
